prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1003; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling northbound on the main roadway in Pasadena, Texas, and entered a signalized intersection on a green light when Driver 2, southbound, proceeded into the intersection and struck the driver side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported dizziness and a headache immediately after the impact and complained of a concussion-type injury at the scene. A Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat and was also present in the vehicle at the time of the collision. Driver 2 stated that he did not see the signal change in time and admitted that the collision occurred as Driver 1 described. Two independent witnesses, one standing at the corner and one in a parked car, gave statements consistent with that account. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the driver side door, quarter panel and window frame that is consistent with a side impact of this type. No prior damage was observed on the vehicle, and no earlier collision damage was reported by either party. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. Injuries reported by Driver 1 are consistent with the forces involved in a crash of this nature, and Driver 1 was transported for medical evaluation.
